intro_formulas: scriptum est, sicut scriptum est, secundum quod scriptum est, dicit scriptura, dicit, ait, inquit, loquitur, testatur, clamat, psallit, canit, docet, monet, praedicat, prophetat, apostolus dicit, propheta dicit
prompt_notes: The text may be patristic or medieval Latin with variant orthography, and may quote the Bible in pre-Vulgate (Vetus Latina) wording or from memory. Quotations must be referenced in Vulgate form and Vulgate numbering (Psalms follow the Vulgate/LXX numbering, which differs from the Hebrew numbering by 1). Ezra and Nehemiah are the separate books ezra and neh.
